basic_info.description: This 1 bed plus den, 1 bath upper-floor condo in the heart of Hayes Valley offers the perfect blend of style, comfort, and convenience. Enjoy the warmth and charm of a south-facing window that fills the space with wonderful natural light throughout the day, your perfect retreat in the city. The open floor plan creates a bright and welcoming vibe for living, working, and entertaining. The gourmet kitchen is designed for both function and flair, featuring stainless steel appliances and sleek granite counters that overlook the living and dining areas. The spacious bedroom and versatile den provide the ideal setup for rest and productivity, while the modern bathroom and in-unit laundry add ease to your daily routine. As a resident, you'll enjoy top-notch amenities including a designated parking spot, front desk concierge, private fitness center, bike storage, and a large rooftop deck with a BBQ area, perfect for gatherings with friends or enjoying city views. 1 car garage parking. Located steps from the SF JAZZ Center, Opera House, Civic Center BART, and MUNI, this home puts you right in the center of everything. Plus, you'll have Hayes Valley's top spots like a Mano, Rich Table, Absinthe, Biergarten, and Hayes Street Grill just outside your door. Luxury city living awaits.
